title: Verify your Discord account
verified: Your Discord account is verified. You can return to Discord.
session-required: Activate participant access in this browser before you can verify your Discord account.
saved-pass-session-required: Your saved QR pass still works at event scanners, but participant access in this browser has expired or was replaced. Ask an organiser to reactivate it.
check-in-required: You must check in before you can verify your Discord account.
invalid: This verification link is missing, invalid, or expired. Generate a new personal link in Discord.
discord-account-conflict: Your Discord account is already linked to a different participant pass. Ask an organiser to reset your Discord verification.
participant-conflict: This participant pass is already linked to a different Discord account. Ask an organiser to reset the participant’s Discord verification.
conflict: Both the participant pass and Discord account have previous verification bindings. Ask an organiser to reset Discord verification.
unavailable: Verification is temporarily unavailable. Try again. If your link expires, generate a new one in Discord.
